sharedBoundary.current: AttackInfo.Mult is consumed as a final native base/talent scaling input in damage resolution; 142 character-flat rules share FlatDmg producers, not the arithmetic that constructs Mult. No dedicated source-host character Mult producer rule/receipt was found in the current registry.
sharedBoundary.exclude: Plain multiplier table lookup by talent/normal counter (for example attack[counter][talent], burst[talent]) is a native table input, not an additional arithmetic producer; don't add rules solely for these lookups.
sharedBoundary.scopeLimit: This is a source-location shortlist from compound assignments and multiplier expressions, not a complete AST count of every Mult field initialization.

recommendedFamily.why: Repeated source pattern across both lanes: talent-level base multiplier plus a talent-level bonus multiplied by a native counter/stack field. Those operations are flattened into final AttackInfo.Mult and have no separate shared arithmetic trace.
